RULE-001.title: Escape-aware forward decoding for embedding look-ahead
RULE-001.note: Look-ahead logic is right. The \v mapping is a defect to FIX in the rewrite: \v must become \u000b (U+000B, vertical tab), and the decoder must return 0x2000B, not \u0008 / 0x20008 (JsonSanitizer.java:740, :1495). Legacy is left unpatched, so equivalence tests must expect this one difference.

RULE-024.title: Over-deep arrays/objects are replaced with null instead of failing
RULE-024.note: Confirmed with the outside reviewer. The no-throw policy is new: 042752c (PR #39, 2026-10-27) reverted the short-lived JsonNestingDepthException from 0c90410 (PR #37) before any release, so earlier published releases behave differently.

RULE-025.title: Output is exactly one top-level value; trailing extra content is discarded

RULE-026.title: Sanitizer output must be idempotent (sanitizing twice changes nothing)
RULE-026.note: The rule is right. The test-diagnostic bugs (:89 excerpts sanitized0 instead of sanitized1; excerpt() double-escapes \r/\n; ellipse flags unused) don't affect pass/fail and are not part of the contract.

RULE-057.title: Neutralize HTML script and XML CDATA breakout sequences in strings
RULE-057.note: Confirmed with the outside reviewer. '<![CDATA[' is not escaped by the code; JsonSanitizerTest.java:343 asserts its absence only for the fuzz inputs it uses. Out of scope, not a security gap.
